survey.source: Michael, direct chat confirmations after physical arm-base calibration review
survey.front_camera_height_reference: User stated front camera height; interpreted provisionally as centre of visible front lens. Exterior lens centre versus internal optical origin offset remains unmeasured.

nose_to_shoulder_horizontal_setback.source_value: very similar to camera setback; nose is bumper over front camera assembly

rough_tape_survey.method: Rough tape readings from owner; exact landmarks and statistical tolerances not independently documented
rough_tape_survey.intended_use: Independent rough crosschecks and initialization, not hard exact constraints or claimed camera-derived dimensions

survey.adoption: Production geometry unchanged pending consistent refit and holdout verification. User expects camera-derived refinement, not replacement of rough readings by asserted precise anatomy. Full-scale printing supports scale assumption but does not quantify printer tolerance.
remaining_unknowns: Chassis rotation-origin location relative to geometric body centre and front camera
Optical centre versus exterior camera housing offset
Along-axis physical shoulder centre and pedestal anatomy
Physical L2/M4 zero/M5 station and exact jaw pad seam

frozen_observations_policy: same archived full corners and grouping; detection not rerun or selected using holdout; old cache never written or assumed valid by count
front_objective: soft_l1 scale0.5, residual (projected-observed)/sqrt(Ncorners) per frame; K,d fixed within scenario
front_holdout_policy: last archived registered frame in each block, all its corners excluded; full_fit is separate reconstruction, never heldout prediction
pincher_holdout_policy: last pose per archived group; orientation conditional on separate settled exposure where available, otherwise same target orientation; NOT independent metrology
